note: Outcome expectations per companion-repo scenario, for SAA-746's codex-claude-agent runner to assert against. Trigger accuracy is the kb-review skill's evals; this file is the other half and cannot run in CI here.
rangeNote: Two-dot, the same form the agent takes. Every scenario branch has main as its merge base, which is what <base> must be.
writtenNote: `writes` and `events` are the two halves of the agent's `written` array: a `writes` entry is an element with `op: "write"`, an `events` entry one with `op: "verify"`, `"status"` or `"rebaseline"`.

writes.why: findMany now dedupes ids, so `missing` is over unique ids and a caller passing duplicates gets a shorter array than it passed.
Nothing records why the dedupe landed; the why is the author's, not the reviewer's to invent.

delta.why: flow.tenant-batch-get is anchored on the changed symbol, so a record does cover the hunk — but no record covers the dedupe, so there was no claim for the base to talk the reviewer out of.

writes.why: The cache has no invalidation and no eviction; the decision does not answer it. A refutation is a question beside the record, never an edit of it.

fabricated-decision.why: No `## Rejected` section and a rationale that restates the title: the record rejected nothing, so there is no claim to check.

delta.why: The pass-1 findings the record's presence would otherwise have absorbed.

events.note: must name the anchor read and the command run

blocking-risk.why: The mitigation names real code at the anchor and the test that pins it exists. `verified` requires both the anchor read and the command run.

events.note: must name the generator run and that the tree came back clean

generated-block.why: The only defensible way to accept 600 generated lines is to re-run the generator. A run that reports `verified` without executing the command fails this scenario.
